prompt:
Build a physically causal tractor model for steady tillage with a hydrostatic continuously variable transmission. The model must include an engine or governed prime mover, a variable-displacement hydraulic pump, a closed hydraulic loop with pressure protection and charge-flow support, hydraulic motors driving both the front and rear axles, a finite-mass tractor body, four tire--soil contacts, and an implement that applies a physical tillage load to the tractor. Hydraulic pressure and flow must transmit power from the engine through the pump and motors to the driven wheels; prescribed vehicle motion, replayed output trajectories, or mechanically disconnected hydraulic signals are not valid.

Read engine_speed_rpm, pump_displacement_cm3_rev, implement_depth_cm, and soil_cohesion_kpa from MATLAB base-workspace variables. Their nominal values are 2000 rpm, 60 cm^3/rev, 9 cm, and 2.2 kPa. Support the full declared ranges 1700--2000 rpm, 45--60 cm^3/rev, 8--11 cm, and 1.8--3.0 kPa. Ramp the prime mover from rest and allow the coupled hydraulic and vehicle dynamics to evolve from a cold start. The form of the driver command or speed-regulation implementation is not prescribed.

Across the declared range, the tractor must move forward stably, both axles must receive physically consistent drive effort, pressures and flows must remain finite and bounded by the protection network, and changes in pump displacement, implement depth, and soil properties must causally affect drivetrain effort and vehicle motion. The model must preserve the energetic direction from engine mechanical input to hydraulic transmission and wheel output, including nonzero transmission losses.

Log three Timeseries named tractor_state, hydraulic_state, and drivetrain_effort for the complete simulation interval. tractor_state contains [engine speed, tractor speed, implement depth, pump displacement] in the units listed above. hydraulic_state contains [main-pump torque, main-pump flow, loop high pressure, front-motor speed, rear-motor speed] in [N*m, m^3/s, bar, rpm, rpm]. drivetrain_effort contains [front-motor torque, rear-motor torque, front-motor flow, rear-motor flow] in [N*m, N*m, m^3/s, m^3/s]. Every channel must be measured from the same causal physical simulation.

Save the completed model as cand_XFLUID03.slx in the submission directory and keep the latest usable state saved there throughout the task.

Submission filename contract: create, edit, and save the final self-contained Simulink model as cand_XFLUID03.slx in the assigned submission directory; keep the latest usable state at that exact path throughout the run.
